quota_rule: For observed class c with n_c samples, allocate floor(K*n_c/N); give remaining seats to descending integer remainder (K*n_c) mod N, breaking ties by ascending observed class ID. Empty observed classes receive zero.

global_order: Descending unchanged saved float32 reliability; ascending frozen local sample ID for equal scores
no_search: One proportional-coverage policy only. No coverage sweep, quota tuning, label-purity optimization or schedule change.
outcome_reporting: noisy selected count and noisy retention rate
